content: Loihhaih poih
Izip prae ah Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah,
Vaihi khrah loe nangcae han khrah tangsuek ah om tih; nangcae han saning amtong tangsuekhaih khrah ah om tih.
Vaihi khrah ni hato naah, kami boih, angmacae imthung takoh maeto mah, tuucaa maeto sin hanah, amkhueng Israel kaminawk boih khaeah thui ah, tiah a naa.
Imthung takoh maeto hanah tuucaa maeto khawt ai nahaeloe, a imtaeng ih kami hoi angcuu o nasoe loe, kami khawt ah tuucaa to sin o nasoe.
Coek koi kaom ai, saningto kaom Tuu tae to sin oh; to loe Tuu, to tih ai boeh loe Ma-eh thung hoiah qoi oh;
to khrah ni hatlai palito pha ai karoek to tuucaa to kahoih ah khen oh loe, ani phak naah amkhueng Israel kaminawk mah to tuucaa to khoving ah bop o tih.
Athii to la oh loe, tuu moi na caak o haih im thok ranuih hoi thok tung ranui ah nok oh.
To na ni duembang ah, hmai pakhaem ih moi to, kakhaa aan hoi taeh thuh ai ih takaw hoiah nawnto caa oh.
Kahaeng moi maw, to tih ai boeh loe tui hoiah bueh ih moi to caa o hmah; toe a lu moi, a khok hoi palung pathinnawk loe hmai pakhaem pacoengah caa oh.
Moi to khawnbang khoek to suem o hmah; kamthlai zetta om nahaeloe, hmai hoiah qoeng oh.
Moi na caak o naah, kaengkaeh to angzaeng oh, khokpanaibum abuen oh loe, ban ah cunghet to sin pacoengah, karangah caa oh; hae loe Angraeng ih loihhaih poih ah oh.
To na ni qum ah Izip prae thung boih ah ka caeh moe, kaminawk ih caa lu hoi tapen tangsuek moi to ka dueksak boih han; Izip sithawnawk to lok ka caek boih han; Kai loe Angraeng ah ka oh.
Athii loe nangcae ohhaih im ah, angmathaih maeto ah om tih; athii ka hnuk naah, nangcae to kang takanh taak han; Izip prae ka tuk naah, nangcae nuiah kasae nathaih pha mak ai.
Hae ani hae pakuem o poe ah; na caanawk dung khoek to hae ani phak naah, Angraeng khaeah buh raenghaih poih to sah oh; sakzong ih atawk baktih toengah, to poih to dungzan khoek to sah oh.

Ni sarihto thung taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh; ni amtong tangsuek naah imthung ih taeh to va oh; ni amtong tangsuek hoi ni sarihto thung taeh thuh ih takaw caa kami loe, Israel acaeng thung hoiah pahnawt oh.
Amtong tangsuekhaih ni hoi sarihto niah, kaciim amkhuenghaih to sah oh; caaknaek khue ai ah loe tok kalah roe sah o hmah.
Hae na ni roe ah Izip prae thung hoiah kang tacawt o haih pongah, taeh thuh ai ih takaw caakhaih poih to sah oh; sakzong ih atawk baktih toengah, na caanawk dung khoek to hae ani hae zaa o poe ah.
Khrah tangsuek, to akhrah ni hathlai palito duembang hoi kamtong ni pumphaeto pacoeng, nito duembang karoek to taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh.
Ni sarihto thung na imthung ah taeh to suem o hmah; angvin maw, to tih ai boeh loe prae thung tapen kami mah maw, taeh thuh ih takaw to caa nahaeloe, Israel acaeng thung hoiah pahnawt oh.
Taeh hoi sak ih takaw to caa o hmah; na ohhaih ahmuen kruekah taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Mosi mah Israel kacoehtanawk to kawk boih moe, nihcae khaeah, Caeh oh, nangmacae imthung takoh kakhawt ah, tuucaa maeto la oh loe, loihhaih poih sak hanah bop oh.
Hissop thing tadok tamsum maeto la oh, sabae kathuk pong ih tuu thii thungah nup oh loe, thok ranui hoi thok tung ranui boih ah nok oh; khawnbang khoek to mi doeh thok tasa bangah caeh o hmah.

Angraeng loe Izip kaminawk hum hanah Izip prae thung boih ah caeh tih; thok ranuih hoi thok tung ranuih boih ah nok ih athii to a hnuk naah, Angraeng mah to im thok to takan taak tih, to tiah kami humkung loe nangcae hum hanah imthung ah akunsak mak ai.
Sakzong ih atawk baktih toengah, hae hmuen hae nangmacae hoi na caanawk mah doeh pazui o poe ah.
Angraeng mah lokkam ih baktih toengah, anih mah paek han thuih ih prae thungah na kun o naah, hae tok hae sah o poe ah.
Na caanawk mah, Hae tok loe tih thuih koehhaih ih maw? tiah na dueng o nahaeloe,

nangcae mah nihcae khaeah, Hae loe Angraeng mah Izip kaminawk to hum moe, kaicae ih im loe pathlung, Izip prae ih Israel kaminawk ih im takan taakhaih, Angraeng ih loihhaih poih ah oh, tiah thui pae oh, tiah a naa. To pacoengah kaminawk mah akuep hoiah bok o.
Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Israel kaminawk mah sak o.
Aqum naah Angraeng mah Izip prae ih caa lu boih, angraeng tangkhang nuiah anghnu, Faro caa lu hoi kamtong thongkrah kami ih caa lu, tapen tangsuek moinawk to dueksak boih.
Faro, anih ih tamnanawk hoi Izip kaminawk loe qum ah angthawk o boih, Izip prae thungah qahhaih to oh; kadueh ai kami im roe maeto doeh om ai.
Loih amtonghaih

Aqum ah Faro mah Mosi hoi Aaron to kawk, Angthawk hoih! Nangmah hnik hoi Israel kaminawk to angthawk oh loe, kai kaminawk khae hoiah caeh o lai ah! Nang hnik hoi ih baktih toengah, Angraeng to bok oh.
Nangmacae ih tuunawk hoi maitawnawk doeh la oh loe, na thuih o ih baktih toengah caeh oh! Kai doeh tahamhoihaih na paek o toengah, tiah a naa.
Izip kaminawk mah, Kaicae loe kadueh kami ah ni ka oh o boih boeh, tiah a thuih o pongah, Israel kaminawk to Izip prae thung hoi karangah haek hanah, kaminawk to karangah pahruek o.
To pongah kaminawk mah taeh thuh ai ih takaw kahaeng to lak o moe, takaw naephaih boengloengnawk doeh kahni hoiah tapawk o pacoengah, palaeng ah aput o.
Mosi mah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Israel kaminawk mah sak o; Izip kaminawk khaeah sui, sum kanglungnawk hoi khukbuennawk to a hnik o;
Angraeng mah Izip kaminawk khaeah tahmenhaih palungthin to paek pongah, nihcae mah hnik ih hmuen boih to a paek o. Nihcae mah Izip kaminawk ih hmuen to lak pae o.
Israel kaminawk loe Rameses hoi Sukkoth ah caeh o; to ah caeh kaminawk loe nongpata hoi nawkta thui ai ah, kami sang cumvai tarukto oh o.
Congca kaminawk loe tuunawk, maitawnawk, paroeai pop moinawk hoi nawnto caeh o.

Izip prae hoi sin o ih, taeh thuh ai ih takaw to lak o moe, taeh thuh ai ih takaw to hmai paop o; nihcae to Izip prae thung hoi karangah haek o, angmacae caak han mataeng doeh sak patok o pongah, takaw to taeh thuh ai ah a sin o.
Israel kaminawk loe Izip prae thungah saning cumvai pali, qui thumto oh o.
Angraeng ih misatuh kaminawk loe saning cumvai pali, qui thumto boeng na niah, Izip prae thung hoiah tacawt o.
Aqum ah Izip prae thung hoi caeh haih hanah, Angraeng mah nihcae to toep pongah, to aqum loe Israel caanawk boih mah zah han koi Angraeng ih aqum ah oh.
Loihhaih poihsakhaih dan
Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah, Hae loe loihhaih poih sakhaih atawk ah oh; to pongah kawbaktih angvin mah doeh caa thai mak ai.
Toe misong ah na qan ih kami loe, tangzat hin aah pacoengah ni, caa tih.
Prae kalah kami, toksak han na tlai ih kaminawk loe caa o thai mak ai.
Im maeto ah caa oh; moi to im tasa bangah sin o hmah; ahuh doeh angkhaek o sak hmah.
Israel kaminawk boih mah to poih to sah oh.

Nangcae thung kaom angvin mah Angraeng loihhaih poih to sak koeh nahaeloe, a imthung takoh ih nongpanawk boih tangzat hin aat o nasoe; to pacoengah ni prae kaminawk baktiah sah o thai tih; tangzat hin aat ai kami loe mi doeh caa thai mak ai.
Prae thung tapen kami hoi nangcae salakah kaom prae kalah kami hanah, kanghmong daan maeto patoh oh, tiah a naa.
Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Israel kaminawk boih mah sak o.
To na niah Angraeng mah Israel misatuh kaminawk to, Izip prae thung hoiah a caeh haih.
